evidence.excerpt:
1. Overview
The ontology models the structure of sandwiches that captures the whole (Sandwich), its parts
(BreadSlice, LayerOfFilling, Filling), and six variants
(SingleDeckerSandwich, DoubleDeckerSandwich, OpenSandwich,
ToastedSandwich, Panini, ClubSandwich).
I also created ﬁve object properties describe how these elements are related: hasBreadSlice that
links a sandwich to each slice of bread; hasLayer links a sandwich to each vertical layer of ﬁlling;
hasFillingIngredient links a layer to any ﬁlling substance (hasMeatFilling and
hasVegetableFilling)
